S0.note: Definitions plus a check that the n = 5 witness has P_γ = (1 − t)^4.

S1a.note: Over ℝ; the 1/N normalisation is dropped since it is a constant factor.

S1b.note: Proved for x_j = j − c with any constant c, so it covers the centred coordinates.

S1c.note: Proved over any commutative ring, via Mathlib's Taylor expansion at 1.

S2a.note: Two theorems: the sum of m distinct values in {1..N}, and the full column bound for an injective filling of the grid.

S2b.note: Lean proves the AM–GM step a(N − a) ≤ N²/4. Combining it with S2a to get ‖γ‖₁ ≤ N²/4 is not formalized; check that line by hand.

S3a.note: Stated with Mathlib's circle average, which is the same integral reparametrised. Uses Mathlib's theorem that a nonzero integer polynomial has Mahler measure ≥ 1.

S3b.note: Proved for all |z| ≤ 1, slightly more than needed.

S3c.note: Same bound as the paper, proved algebraically (a discrete Taylor remainder and the hockey-stick identity) instead of with an integral.

S3d.note: Holds for all m and K ≥ 1.

S3e.note: The chord bound. Turning S3b–S3e into the pointwise log bound is a short step that is not separately formalized.

S3g.note: Lean checks the arithmetic. Integrating the pointwise bound of S3e around the circle to get I ≤ log L − 2K/β is not formalized; check that line by hand.

S4a.note: Lean checks the final contradiction from the three inequalities; the inputs are S3g, S2b and S1c.
